$comment: GENERATED by _scripts/build-figures.mjs — do not edit by hand.

layerDropRule.rule: a ring narrower than 8px stops reading as cut paper, so the figure drops a layer and the remaining rings widen. This is the thumbnail rule: a thumbnail is not a shrunk card image, it is the same figure with fewer layers.

spot.purpose: small thematic mark beside a text block; one per section, never one per item

banner.purpose: wide, short, carries text — the system-owned replacement for the server-rendered capsule banner, which animates with no pause control
banner.fontCaveat: an SVG loaded as an image cannot reach a webfont, so the text falls back to the viewer's stack. The line is short, single and left-aligned so a metric difference cannot break the layout. This is the same Level 1 exception the handbook already carries for GitHub's typography.

ornament.purpose: rhythm and separation at a section boundary; the plain hairline remains the default divider

thumbnail.rule: never separately authored and never a shrunk card image: the same figure with the layer count the size allows. See layerDropRule.

cardImage.origin: the section spot, not a per-item drawing
cardImage.rule: a card image identifies the SECTION, not the item. This system has one mark; a per-item variation of it would be decoration pretending to be identification, and the item is already identified by its name and its DOI.

keyArt.rule: key art is campaign-level and there is no campaign. A one-person system that ships key art ships an asset with no occasion.

scrim.rule: a scrim is alpha, and every role here is solid and separately solved so that nothing changes meaning over a different ground. Text never sits on imagery: the hero splits rather than overlays.
